es: Convertir una tabla de datos en una historia: tendencia con cifras, comparación, interpretación prudente y proyección, unidas con conectores.

teaching.en: Overall, the number of swimming sessions rose from two to three a week, which is in line with the school's new health plan.
teaching.es: En general, el número de sesiones de natación subió de dos a tres por semana, lo que está en consonancia con el nuevo plan de salud del colegio.
teaching.explanationEs: Overall abre el párrafo con la tendencia general; las cifras van después con from… to…. In line with relaciona un dato con un plan o una norma.

teaching.explanationEs: By contrast y meanwhile contrastan dos líneas del gráfico: la primera opone dos datos; la segunda los sitúa a la vez.

teaching.en: Runners tend to improve faster in spring, and the figures appear to show that longer days play a part.
teaching.es: Los corredores tienden a mejorar más rápido en primavera, y las cifras parecen mostrar que los días más largos influyen.
teaching.explanationEs: Tend to y appear to son interpretaciones prudentes: dicen lo que sugieren los datos sin afirmar la causa.

teaching.explanationEs: If this trend continues abre la proyección; overtake es superar a otro en una comparación; consequently añade la consecuencia, con may para la prudencia.

teaching.explanationEs: Interpretation y partly señalan que es una lectura posible de los datos, no un hecho.

prompt.es: Lee las notas del informe y elige la frase que abre con la tendencia general.

choices.text: Overall, running sessions rose from two to three a week, whereas swimming stayed the same.
Overall, swimming sessions rose from two to three a week, whereas running stayed the same.
Overall, both activities rose from two to three sessions a week, in line with the plan.

feedback.es: Solo la natación pasó de dos a tres sesiones; la carrera se mantuvo en tres, así que la apertura correcta contrasta ambas líneas.

hint.es: Busca qué actividad cambió y cuál se quedó igual.

origin.text: Notes for the health report: in 2022 the school offered two swimming sessions and three running sessions a week. In 2025 it offers three of each. Swimming is the only activity that has grown in these three years.

prompt.es: Completa: «En comparación con la carrera, la natación es ahora más popular.»

feedback.es: Compared with + dato introduce la comparación; aquí contrasta la natación con la carrera, que apenas cambió.

hint.es: Es el participio que va antes de with para abrir una comparación.

origin.text: Swimming doubled over three years. ___ with running, which barely changed, it is now the school's most popular activity.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué dice la profesora sobre el motivo del aumento de ciclistas.

choices.text: That it has been clearly proved to come from the new bike shelter at school.
That it is caused by students who have stopped walking.
That it may be partly due to the new shelter, though nobody has checked.

feedback.es: La profesora usa seems to y partly, y añade que nadie lo ha comprobado: es una interpretación prudente, no una causa probada.

origin.audio: Let me describe the chart for the school website. Overall, cycling to school has become more popular: the number of students who cycle rose from sixty to ninety in two years. By contrast, walking stayed almost the same. The increase seems to be partly linked to the new bike shelter, although nobody has checked this. If the trend continues, cycling is likely to overtake walking next year.

origin.audio: In the meeting, the coordinator presented the school's sports figures. Overall, tennis rose from thirty-five to seventy-one players in three years, whereas football stayed at around eighty. One teacher said that the new indoor court had caused the rise. The coordinator answered carefully: the increase appears to be partly linked to the court, but the budget did not change, so other reasons could matter too. She would not call it a cause. If the trend continues, she added, tennis is likely to overtake football, and in that case the school may need extra coaches.

prompt.es: Escribe el informe: tendencia, comparación, interpretación prudente y proyección.

answer.text: Overall, the number of students who play tennis rose steadily from 35 in 2022 to 71 in 2025, so it has roughly doubled in three years. Compared with tennis, football hardly changed: around 80 students took part every year. Meanwhile, the difference between the two sports has narrowed from 45 students to only 12, although football remains the more popular sport. The biggest jump came in 2024, when 14 more students joined. This appears to be partly linked to the new indoor court, although the figures do not prove it. By contrast, the school budget stayed the same, which suggests that other reasons also matter. If this trend continues, tennis is likely to overtake football by 2026; consequently, the school may need extra coaches. Of course, this is only an estimate.

prompt.es: Lee el párrafo: ¿con qué propósito añade el autor «the figures do not prove it»?

choices.text: To hide that the new homework policy has failed.
To show that the sample is too small to be published.
To avoid claiming more than the data allow.

feedback.es: La salvedad sirve para no afirmar más de lo que los datos permiten: la relación es posible, no demostrada.

origin.text: Overall, the average time that students spend on homework fell from 95 to 80 minutes a night. This appears to be partly linked to the new homework policy, although the figures do not prove it, and the sample covers only one year group.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué explicación considera más probable el hablante.

choices.text: That two new players scored most of the extra goals.
That the new ball made the matches much more exciting.
That the number of matches increased a lot during the season.

feedback.es: El hablante descarta el balón nuevo y prefiere la explicación más simple: dos jugadores nuevos marcaron la mayoría de los goles extra.

origin.audio: Compared with last year, the average number of goals per match rose from two to three. Meanwhile, the number of matches stayed the same. Some fans say that the new ball is the reason, but the data tend to support a simpler explanation: two new players joined the team in September, and they scored most of the extra goals.

feedback.es: Interpretation nombra una lectura posible de los datos, que solo se acepta como explicación si otras pruebas la confirman.
